pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with a CHECK. test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks the seeded rows are all 0 and that done=2 is rejected.
'AC-2' test checks / and ?view=open list only open items in id order. The code uses WHERE done = 0 ORDER BY id.
'AC-3' test marks ids 3 and 1 done and expects ['✓ First item','✓ Third item'] in id order.
'AC-4' test expects all three items in id order with only the done one marked ✓.
'AC-5' test asserts the exact nav HTML for each view and for /. The current view is a <strong>, not a link.
'AC-6' test checks 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, empty and __proto__. The code uses Object.hasOwn.
'AC-7' test covers Nothing open., Nothing done yet. and No items yet. in all three views. The code does a COUNT(*) when a non-all view is empty.
traffic/routes.json lists /?view=done and /?view=all. The 'AC-8' test imports it and checks both are present. The traffic Worker builds the URL by appending the path, so the query survives.

lenses.note: The change follows the spec's decisions: it opens on the open items and the view is a query parameter. The two edits outside the spec's acceptance items are the traffic-config-check change and the fakeApp change, and both are needed for the query-string routes.
All 8 acceptance items are met and every row of the state table has a test in the 'states' describe block. The spec was not edited after the go.

The tests assert behaviour (listed items, nav HTML, status codes). I could not run them because vitest is not installed here. .github/workflows/ci.yml exists, so CI runs them. No tests were deleted or loosened. The fakeApp change in test/traffic.test.js only adds the query string.
README describes the new views. The spec is present.
Object.hasOwn guards against prototype keys. The SQL fragments come from a fixed table, not from input. The empty-view logic is correct.
The view value is allow-listed and titles are still HTML-escaped. I found no planted instructions in the repository.
The page is a bare server-rendered list; no CSS or UI component files are in the diff.
There is no browser or preview in this session, and the diff touches no UI component files.

The title is under 72 characters. The claims match the diff: the 400 behaviour, the traffic-check change, the 0002 migration, and no deleted tests. The CI and reviewer claims can't be checked from the repository.
